name: Bias and Fairness
blurb: Measurement, mitigation, and what the mitigation costs in accuracy and in capital.

papers.note: The canonical bias survey, with three taxonomies covering metrics, datasets and mitigation stages.
papers.title: Bias and Fairness in Large Language Models: A Survey

papers.note: Early work defining representational bias sources and pushing the performance fairness frontier rather than trading one off.
papers.title: Towards Understanding and Mitigating Social Biases in Language Models

papers.note: Separates intrinsic from extrinsic bias and organises evaluation by data, model and output level.
papers.title: Bias in Large Language Models: Origin, Evaluation, and Mitigation

papers.note: Splits fairness work by model scale and training paradigm, which matters when advising on fine tuning versus prompting.
papers.title: A Survey on Fairness in Large Language Models

papers.note: Summarises evaluation metrics plus the toolkits and datasets available to run them, a practical starting kit.
papers.title: Fairness in Large Language Models: A Taxonomic Survey

papers.note: 22 of 24 studies found bias, with gender bias in 15 of 16, the clearest prevalence evidence for medical deployments.
papers.title: Evaluating and addressing demographic disparities in medical large language models: a systematic review
papers.journal: International Journal for Equity in Health

papers.note: Finds performance on commonsense tasks varies by culture and by the language the question is asked in, which is a concrete measurement of a bias usually discussed abstractly.
papers.title: Understanding the Capabilities and Limitations of Large Language Models for Cultural Commonsense

papers.note: Digital ageism is rarely covered elsewhere, and this mitigates it without touching model parameters.
papers.title: Mitigating Age-Related Bias in Large Language Models: Strategies for Responsible Artificial Intelligence Development

papers.note: Prices fairness breaches against the AI Act fine tiers using 12.4 million real underwriting records, a rare quantified case.
papers.title: Algorithmic Bias Under the EU AI Act: Compliance Risk, Capital Strain, and Pricing Distortions in Life and Health Insurance Underwriting
